description: Machine-readable change risk tiers. Human-readable counterpart: docs/risk-tiers.md (kept in sync by tests/test_risk_config.py).
rule: A change takes the highest tier of any file it touches.

tiers.name: normal
tiers.review: Tests added or updated; CI green; human review

tiers.name: high
tiers.review: Human review required; state the failure mode and how it was tested; never lower the coverage gate

tiers.name: critical
tiers.review: Human-authored or human-applied only; agents open an issue with the exact replacement text instead of a PR
